description: OPENS THE PUBLISH CARD RIGHT HERE for a post `prepare_post` has already staged: the user watches the actual video, sees the destination account, edits the caption, picks the visibility, sets the commercial disclosure themselves, ticks a box saying they want it posted and confirms twice. NOTHING IS PUBLISHED BY THIS CALL OR BY THE CARD. CALL IT IMMEDIATELY AFTER `prepare_post` ON ANY CLIENT THAT RENDERS CARDS, then STOP: say one short line (the post is on screen for them to check) and wait. Do not recite the caption, list the privacy options, or ask 'public or friends-only?' or whether they want it posted: those are controls on the card, and asking in chat is what this tool replaces. WHAT COMES BACK IS A MESSAGE FROM THE USER and it is your signal: the card writes one turn saying they approve, naming the destination, visibility, disclosure and a post id. That id is a FRESH post staged from their own choices: use it, not the one `prepare_post` gave you, call `publish_post` with it and nothing else, then poll `get_post_status`. Until it arrives there is nothing to do (no polling, no `publish_post`, no new prepare). If they change their mind in the card nothing arrives and nothing is staged: a complete outcome. If they say they cannot see a card, or there is no card surface (a terminal, a script), ask in the message exactly as `publish_post` describes and do not call this again. COSTS NOTHING AND SENDS NOTHING: it reads a post you already prepared, stages nothing and reaches no platform. OUTPUT: the prepared post, for the card; do not paste or summarise it.

post_id.description: The `id` `prepare_post` returned; the card reads the post back from it.

name: review_post
title: Show the user the post before it goes out
